traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Tofieldiaceae with Japonolirionaceae, which APG and WCVP join to it (their extra states read as sometimes): leaves alternate; leaves simple; veins parallel; blades linear or lanceolate, rarely ovate; leaf rosettes basal or none; plants usually hermaphrodite, sometimes dioecious or polygamous; ovary superior or half inferior; stems herbaceous; flowers in racemes, in spikes or in panicles; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit capsule; parts of each whorl 3; stamens 6 to 12; carpels 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
